blocks.text: Jo chemical enzyme ke kaam mein rukawat dale aur use rok de, use inhibitor (rokne wala) kehte hain. Inhibitors enzymes se jur jate hain lekin khud products mein nahin badalte; is tarah woh active sites ko thori der ke liye (temporarily) ya hamesha ke liye (permanently) band kar dete hain. Is amal ko enzyme inhibition kehte hain. Pecheeda enzyme reactions ke aakhri products bhi pehle qadam ke enzyme ke inhibitor ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Inhibitors bataur dawa aur zehar
blocks.text: Inhibitors aksar dawaon (drugs) ke taur par istemal hote hain, lekin yeh zehar (poison) bhi ban sakte hain. Dawa ke taur par istemal hone wale inhibitor ki misal aspirin hai: yeh un enzymes ko rokti hai jo prostaglandin banate hain (prostaglandin sozish yani inflammation paida karta hai). Is liye aspirin dard aur sozish kam karti hai. Zehar cyanide ek irreversible (na palatne wala) inhibitor hai jo enzyme cytochrome oxidase ke active site mein maujood copper aur iron se jur kar cellular respiration rok deta hai.
Inhibitors ki qismein
Competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors

Inhibitors ki do bari qismein mani jati hain: competitive aur non-competitive. Competitive inhibitor shakal mein enzyme ke substrate jaisa hota hai. Yeh enzyme ki usi binding site ke liye substrate se muqabla (competition) karta hai. Jab binding site inhibitor ko pakar leti hai to active site band ho jati hai aur substrate nahin jur sakta. Is tarah enzyme kaam nahin kar pata (Figure 5.9).

blocks.title: Competitive inhibitors bataur antibiotics
blocks.text: Competitive inhibitors bacteria ko maarne ke liye antibiotics ke taur par istemal hote hain. Yeh inhibitor molecules banawat mein bacteria ke zaroori enzymes ke substrates jaise hote hain; is liye yeh un enzymes se jur kar unhein rok dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein likha hai ke yeh inhibitors “bacteria ke enzymes jaisi banawat” rakhte hain. Sahi yeh hai ke competitive inhibitor substrate jaisa hota hai, enzyme jaisa nahin (kitab khud upar yahi kehti hai). Yani antibiotic molecules bacteria ke enzymes ke substrates jaise hote hain aur un enzymes ki active site band kar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do marhale. Gurde (kidney) jaisa enzyme jis ka active site V jaisa hai; substrate aur milti-julti shakal ka inhibitor dono us ki taraf barhte hain (Competition between substrate and inhibitor). Phir inhibitor active site mein beth jata hai aur substrate bahar reh jata hai (Inhibitor attaches with active site and blocks it); nuqtedar teer No products tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Inhibitor, Active site, Enzyme.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.9: Enzyme ki competitive inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Inhibitor ki shakal substrate jaisi hai, is liye dono ek hi active site ke liye muqabla (competition) karte hain. Jab inhibitor site mein beth jata hai to substrate jur nahin sakta aur products nahin bante. Misal: succinic dehydrogenase ke active site par malonic acid, succinic acid se muqabla karta hai.

Enzyme succinic dehydrogenase succinic acid ko oxidise kar ke fumaric acid banata hai. Malonic acid ki banawat substrate (succinic acid) se milti julti hai, is liye dono enzyme ki active site ke liye muqabla karte hain. Jab active site malonic acid ko pakar leti hai to woh band ho jati hai.

Non-competitive inhibitor ki banawat substrate se bilkul nahin milti, is liye yeh active site mein dakhil nahin hota. Is ki bajaye yeh enzyme ki kisi aur jagah se jurta hai. Is ke jurne se enzyme ki shakal badal jati hai, active site substrate ke qabil nahin rehti aur enzyme ruk jata hai (Figure 5.10).

blocks.alt: Teer se jure teen marhale. Gol enzyme jis ka active site cone jaise substrate ke mutabiq tikona (wedge) hai, aur neeche baen taraf ek doosri chhoti jeb (pocket); paas ek peela inhibitor. Inhibitor us jeb se jurta hai (Enzyme-inhibitor complex). Phir active site ek tang seedhi darar ban jata hai jo substrate se nahin milta (Shape of active site altered); nuqtedar teer No products tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Active site, Enzyme, Inhibitor.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.10: Enzyme ki non-competitive inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan inhibitor substrate jaisa nahin aur active site mein dakhil nahin hota; woh enzyme ki doosri jagah jurta hai. Is ke jurne se enzyme ki shakal badalti hai: active site ka tikona shigaf seedhi tang darar ban jata hai, substrate fit nahin hota aur products nahin bante.

Kitab ki misal: do substrates, succinic acid aur CoA, mil kar succinyl-CoA banate hain. Is reaction ko enzyme succinyl-CoA synthetase catalyse karta hai. Banne ke baad product, yani succinyl CoA, non-competitive inhibitor ban kar enzyme se jurta hai. Is tarah enzyme ruk jata hai aur mazeed succinyl-CoA nahin banta.
Reversible aur irreversible inhibitors
Kisi inhibitor ka asar irreversible (pakka, na palatne wala) ya reversible (palatne wala) ho sakta hai; yeh is par munhasir hai ke inhibitor aur enzyme ke darmiyan kis qism ka bond banta hai.

Irreversible inhibitors enzyme ke saath covalent (mazboot) bonds banate hain. Aise inhibitors ko dilution (pani mila kar halka karna), dialysis ya substrate barha kar alag nahin kiya ja sakta. Maslan penicillin us enzyme ko hamesha ke liye nakara kar deta hai jo bacteria ki cell wall banata hai.

Reversible inhibitors enzyme ke saath kamzor bonds (maslan hydrogen bonds) banate hain. Aise inhibitors alag ho sakte hain aur substrate ki concentration barha kar in ka asar khatam kiya ja sakta hai. Maslan malonate reversible inhibitor hai. Yeh cellular respiration mein kaam aane wale enzyme succinate dehydrogenase ko rok kar reaction ko thori der ke liye sust kar deta hai. Malonate hata diya jaye to yeh rukawat khatam ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Enzyme inhibition ki ahmiyat
Enzyme inhibition bohat se biological amal mein bohat aham hai.

items: Enzyme inhibition metabolic raston ko control (regulate) karne mein bunyadi kirdar ada karti hai. Khaas enzymes ko rok kar kisi metabolic reaction ki raftar control ki ja sakti hai.

Bohat si dawaein inhibitors ka kaam karti hain. Maslan antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes rokti hain, aur cancer ki dawaein cell division (cell ke taqseem hone) mein kaam aane wale enzymes rok sakti hain.

Enzyme inhibitors mukhtalif beemariyon ke ilaj mein istemal hote hain. Maslan khoon jamne (blood clotting) wale enzymes ke kuch inhibitors anticoagulants (khoon jamne se rokne wali dawaein) ke taur par istemal hote hain.
Kuch toxins aur zehar jism ke aham enzymes ko rok dete hain. Yeh samajhna ke yeh inhibitors enzymes par kaise asar karte hain, zehar ke mareezon ke ilaj mein bohat zaroori ho sakta hai.
Enzyme inhibitors dawa sazi ki tehqeeq (pharmaceutical research) mein qeemti auzaar hain. In se khaas enzymes ke kaam aur nayi dawaon ka mutala kiya jata hai.

blocks.text: Enzyme inhibition enzyme kinetics (enzyme ke kaam ki raftar ka ilm) ka aham hissa hai. Is se un awamil ko samajhne mein madad milti hai jo enzyme ki sargarmi par asar dalte hain.
Enzymes ki feedback inhibition

Hum jante hain ke metabolic raston mein ek reaction ka product agle reaction ka substrate banta hai. Raste ke aakhir mein matloob (desired) product banta hai. Is product ki miqdar control karne ke liye raste ko band karna parta hai. Yeh kaam feedback inhibition se hota hai: raste ka aakhri product khud inhibitor ban jata hai. Yeh shuru ke kisi enzyme se jur kar us ki shakal (conformation) badal deta hai. Woh enzyme ab apne substrate se nahin jur sakta, is liye rasta band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahin banta (Figure 5.11).
Maslan jab cell mein zaroorat se zyada ATP ho jaye to ATP khud non-competitive inhibitor ban kar us enzyme ko rok deta hai jo ATP banata hai.

blocks.title: Feedback inhibition
blocks.text: Feedback inhibition woh amal hai jis mein kisi amal ka product khud us amal ko control karta hai, aur aksar mazeed product banna mehdood kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche ek raasta (pathway): substrate enzyme 1 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate A banata hai; A enzyme 2 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate B banata hai; B enzyme 3 mein jata hai jo end product (hara chokor) banata hai. Feedback ka teer end product se wapas enzyme 1 tak jata hai, jo upar dikhaya gaya hai: end product us ke pehlu se jura hai aur substrate bahar hai (Enzyme inhibited); nuqtedar teer No more product tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.11: Enzyme ke kaam ki feedback inhibition (kitab ki Figure 5.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Neeche ek raasta (pathway): substrate enzyme 1 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate A banata hai; A enzyme 2 mein jata hai jo intermediate substrate B banata hai; B enzyme 3 mein jata hai jo end product (hara chokor) banata hai. Feedback ka teer end product se wapas enzyme 1 tak jata hai, jo upar dikhaya gaya hai: end product us ke pehlu se jura hai aur substrate bahar hai (Enzyme inhibited); nuqtedar teer No more product tak jata hai. Labels: Substrate, Enzyme 1, Enzyme 2, Enzyme 3, Intermediate Substrate A, Intermediate Substrate B, End product, Feedback, Enzyme inhibited, No more product.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche baen se daen chalein: har enzyme ki paidawar agle enzyme ka substrate banti hai. Jab end product (hara chokor) zyada ho jata hai to woh wapas jaa kar pehle enzyme se uski doosri jagah jurta hai (non-competitive inhibitor ki tarah). Enzyme 1 ruk jata hai, poora raasta band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahin banta. Misal: zaroorat se zyada ATP, ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek laboratory ruke hue enzyme mein zyada substrate dalti hai. Kin sooraton mein raftar bahal hogi, aur cyanide ki zehar-khurani is tarah kyun theek nahin hoti?
blocks.explanation: Raftar tab bahal hoti hai jab inhibitor competitive aur reversible ho, kyunke izafi substrate binding site ke liye use haraa deta hai aur kamzor bonds use hatne dete hain (succinate dehydrogenase par malonate). Cyanide cytochrome oxidase ke copper aur lohe se irreversible taur par aise bonds se jurta hai jo dilution, dialysis ya zyada substrate se nahin toot-te, is liye respiration ruki rehti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Inhibitor enzyme se jur kar product bane baghair use rok deta hai; inhibitors dawaein (aspirin, antibiotics, anticoagulants) bhi hain aur zehar (cyanide) bhi.

Competitive inhibitors substrate jaise hote hain aur binding site ke liye muqabla karte hain (malonic acid); non-competitive inhibitors kahin aur jur kar enzyme ki shakal badalte hain (succinyl-CoA, ATP).
Reversible inhibitors kamzor bonds banate hain aur substrate barhane se hat jate hain (malonate); irreversible inhibitors covalent bonds banate hain (penicillin, cyanide).
Feedback inhibition: raste ka aakhri product pehle enzyme ko rokta hai, jaise zyada ATP apni tayyari rokta hai.
